owner: Codex in James-approved Peninsula Insider task
finding: Four remaining Stay records needed operator review. Iluka had the wrong locality and map pin and overstated its glamping setup. Kanasta omitted shared bathrooms and had an unsettled pet policy. Mantons was called a suite despite no operator confirmation of room type, and its map pin was inaccurate. Driftaway had no current operator booking source yet remained recommended, with an uncredited CMS image on its historical page.
hypothesis: Pausing unverified recommendations, aligning every active format and location to operator sources, and showing rights-cleared illustrative media will improve decision trust without inventing current booking availability.
boundedChange: Pause Driftaway in discovery, search and booking actions while retaining a noindex historical reference. Suppress its old CMS hero and use a visibly disclosed, sourced Sorrento coast illustration. Correct Iluka to operator-published Shoreham address, retire former address and inaccurate coordinate claims, and withhold its map pin. Clarify Iluka tents for two and shared unpowered camp facilities. Clarify Kanasta retro vans, shared bathrooms, air conditioning and operator pet-policy uncertainty. Clarify Mantons accommodation and Friday-Sunday lunch; withhold inaccurate coordinates and classify it as generic accommodation across the schema, maps and directory. Replace the three active records hero fallbacks with credited and disclosed illustrations, reject uncredited CMS overrides, and update related Stay summaries.
metric: Twenty-six currently listable Stay records each have an attributable operator or manager source dated 2026-09-30 or later. The one additional unverified record is paused and excluded from current recommendations. The four reviewed detail pages must render accurate formats and locations, correct image provenance, and no false current booking route for Driftaway.
rollback: Revert this bounded content and taxonomy commit; no data migration. Restore previously listed venue type only with new operator evidence.
